q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password." We will email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month. Annual billing saves you 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month. For 5 people, the total cost is $40 before any annual discounts.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the free plan.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to process the refund.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: I'm sorry, but refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase. Since you purchased the plan three weeks ago, you are no longer eligible. Would you like me to open a support ticket for further assistance?

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app, but Linux users can access the web app through any modern browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Android 12 or later is required; it will not run on Android 11.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires a connection to work. The mobile and desktop apps are the only versions that function offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. You can restore your note by opening Trash, selecting the note, and clicking "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, we do not support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. You can use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the file size limit is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep paid features until the end of the current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. They are encrypted both at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We typically reply within one business day. You can reach us at support@example.com.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices with the Plus plan.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know if we offer a student discount, as I didn't find an answer in the FAQ. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know, as the FAQ doesn't mention importing from Evernote. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app currently, so I don't know when it will be released. Linux users can use the web app in the meantime. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.

q: And how do I undo that?

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan provides shared workspaces.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: Plus and Team allow 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた場合」をクリックしてください。30分以内に有効なリセットリンクがメールで送信されます。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I’m sorry to hear your notes are missing. If you accidentally deleted them, they stay in Trash for 30 days where you can restore them. If not, please email support@example.com so we can investigate further.
